 assert not config["use_dora"] and not config["use_rslora"] and config["modules_to_save"] is None
 raw=(directory/"adapter_model.safetensors").read_bytes()
 length=struct.unpack("<Q",raw[:8])[0]
 assert 0<length<1024**2
 header=json.loads(raw[8:8+length])
 payload=raw[8+length:]
 keys=[k for k in header if k!="__metadata__"]

 for layer in range(28):
  for module in ["q_proj","v_proj"]:
   for matrix in ["A","B"]:
    expected.append("base_model.model.model.layers."+str(layer)+".self_attn."+module+".lora_"+matrix+".weight")

 digest=hashlib.sha256()
 tensors=[]
 total=0
 intervals=[]

  b=payload[lo:hi]
  registered=name.replace(".lora_A.weight",".lora_A.default.weight").replace(".lora_B.weight",".lora_B.default.weight")
  digest.update(canon({"name":registered,"dtype":"torch.float32","shape":shape}))
  digest.update(b)
  tensors.append({"saved_name":name,"registered_name":registered,"shape":shape,"dtype":"F32","bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
  intervals.append((lo,hi))
  total+=math.prod(shape)
 intervals=sorted(intervals)
